title: Extending a segment prefix by one entry
statement: Let $\mu:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, let $a,k\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $l$ be a finite list of natural numbers. Suppose that $\mu$ agrees with the integer cast of the list consisting of the first $k$ entries of $l$ at every index in the segment starting at $a$, and that $k<|l|$. Change $\mu$ at index $a+k$ to the integer represented by the $k$th entry of $l$. The resulting function agrees with the integer cast of the first $k+1$ entries of $l$ throughout the segment starting at $a$.
